title: How do I petition to Graduate
content: Petitioning to graduate is an important milestone in your academic career. Students at Lemoore College may apply for graduation online, safely and conveniently from any remote location, through a dedicated module designed to be convenient and time-efficient. A detailed guide titled Petition to Graduate Guide walks students through the graduation application steps. If students are unsure about eligibility or cannot locate their program, they should consult with a counselor before submitting their petition. The Admissions & Records office provides support at (559) 925-3317, with in-person services available Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, plus virtual options via Zoom or phone.
